name: bipartite_check
author: 7780ae37
description: Tests whether a graph is bipartite, i.e. whether its nodes can be split into two groups with no edge inside a group (for example students versus projects, or two-colourable conflict graphs). Use it for questions like 'is this graph bipartite?', 'can the nodes be split into two groups with no links inside a group?' or 'what are the two sides?'. Edge direction is ignored, so it works on directed and undirected graphs. If bipartite, returns both sides (size, a sample of top_k nodes with ids and labels, and a subgraph id for each). If not, returns a shortest-found odd cycle as proof, with its subgraph id.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to check, e.g. 'projects' or 'karate'.

top_k.description: How many nodes of each side to list in the result.
